> Trait/Stats Tab:

(Use the in game increments to apply whatever value you want to the stat.)

Auto Ascension

Auto Trait Priority System:
Features all Mythics, Legendaries, and Epics along with Hexed.

The script will choose whichever traits you have inside the dropdown, focusing on the traits that have the highest priority out of the other traits.

Example
Lowest:
N/A

Low:
Vampiric

High:
Godly

Highest:
Egotistical Godly

If the user gets a Godly trait (Or already has it) and Vampirism is inside a trait hand while the toggle is active, the script will ignore it and discard it. If Egotistical Godly is inside a trait hand, it will override the Godly it currently has and choose Egotistical Godly.

If you which to not use this system, simply choose all the traits you want to farm for inside one of the priority drop downs.

Ability Swap:
After getting the highest priority trait (Ego Godly for my example.) You have a dropdown that allows you to choose any stand/ability within your inventory and equip it.

Post-Swap Trait Priorities:
You're allowed the make the script look for its own set of traits that aren't the traits that were previously chosen at the top of the UI.
